# A test binary that never renders a template still ran muxt's template
# engine, and its profile, written as it starts, says so: coverage is
# known and empty. No test reaches any action, so every mutant is
# skipped as unreached rather than run, and the run passes; -v lists
# them under "no test reaches".

muxt test-template-mutations -v --seed 1
cmp stdout want.txt
! stderr 'warning:'

-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.27
-- templates.gohtml --
{{define "page"}}Hello, {{.Name}}!{{if .Admin}} {{.Secret}}{{end}}{{end}}
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"io"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateFiles embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateFiles, "*.gohtml"))

type Page struct {
	Name   string
	Admin  bool
	Secret string
}

func Render(w io.Writer, page Page) error {
	return templates.ExecuteTemplate(w, "page", page)
}
-- render_test.go --
package server

import "testing"

func TestNothingRendered(t *testing.T) {
	if templates.Lookup("page") == nil {
		t.Fatal("no page template")
	}
}
